feature: 模型下发SSH调试与实时更新/服务日志
development: local development, isolated tests and build; then update server115

backend.command: python -m pytest tests/test_gpu_terminal.py tests/test_deployment_logs_executor.py tests/test_model_deployment.py tests/test_training_runs.py tests/test_distribution_center.py tests/test_image_updates.py tests/test_image_preload.py -q --disable-warnings --tb=short
scope: named SSH selection and configuration revocation

coverage: pause and manual retry preserve old content
named SSH requires click to connect

limits: service logs are bounded snapshots, not an unbounded stream
runtime verification is recorded separately at server .runtime/deployment-monitoring-acceptance.json
no real model transfer, activation, image preload or inference restart performed
